p.CODKIT-IS-CLEAN-ROOM: Codkit implementation is derived from its specifications, tests, and public VS Code behavior; it does not copy implementations from unrelated fork-management tools.

facts.FORBID-COPY: Do not copy source text, tests, comments, or distinctive internal structure from reference products.
facts.ALLOW-UPSTREAM: The selected VS Code upstream is implementation input, not a prohibited reference repository.
facts.RESEARCH-SEPARATE: Comparative research produces prose facts; implementation sessions consume ratified specifications.
facts.CHECK-CLEAN-ROOM: The clean-room checker and focused review verify the boundary before release.
